about_the_game:
Oh, so you want a DEMO for Wet Dreams Spa? you are in the right place this demo is a short version of the game and it includes everything EVERYTHING, the 36 guys for you to unlock the 37 uncensored pictures for your to collect, you can access to all the areas of the city, the Spa and the VIP area which is even bigger than the city and the main spa together.

This demo has everything except the saving feature (auto saving) you know... because it's A DEMO and this demo has a short timer, why a short timer you ask? because it's a DEMO but more important is that you can access to all the characters if you know where to find them but no worries, this demo has unlimited uses and that means you can unlock two characters in your first run and then go from other path to unlock another characters and you can get the first 10 characters in the main Area.

So you have access to EVERYTHING and you can have a glimpse of WET DREAMS SPA and you get excited for continuing exploring the SPA and open the VIP area, go to the maze, the disco, the sauna, the steam room, the dark room, the laboratory, the showers, the bathroom, the private rooms, the bar, the garden, the pools, the big pool, the tubs, the concierge room, the YA-SS-MU-TH-UR room, the tunnels, the basement, the sister hong's room,, the hypnosis room, the stores, the cascades, the terrace, the gym, the thermal pools, the cave, the manager room and many others... so yeah you have a bunch of places to explore and to have fun inside the spa.

I hope you enjoy this game and if you like it you wishlist it or get it, in a future I'll be creating more games thanks to all the support!

Thank you so much for playing it!
